cases.request: Help me write a prompt for an agent to redesign our onboarding so it feels polished and converts better.
expect: Produces a ready-to-use prompt instead of redesigning the product
Turns polished and converts better into proposed observable criteria
Asks only questions whose answers materially change the prompt

cases.request: Turn my goal of making a photorealistic product render into a detailed prompt and add a loop that keeps improving it until it matches the reference.
expect: Defines comparison evidence and an explicit pass bar
Uses independent grading conditionally rather than assuming a specific client feature
Does not invent a fixed iteration cap that weakens until-done persistence

cases.request: Use this prompt to improve the local page and keep iterating until the acceptance tests pass.
expect: Executes only within the available local project and stated authority
Evaluates the actual artifact on every cycle
Does not claim completion until required tests pass
Reports a blocker instead of broadening authority
Explains how the skill turns goals into verifiable prompts without drafting one
Lists draft, loop-ready, and execute modes and distinguishes writing from execution
Provides a starter and another realistic example for every mode
Invites the user to choose a mode or provide a goal
Handles the direct edit without turning it into a prompt-design exercise
